name: @vos/journal
description: Journal VOS — Journal + Habit PWA auf fuel-dev Shell (Firestore via fitness-aos)

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:cloud && firebase deploy --only hosting:journal --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:cloud: pnpm run build:cloud && firebase deploy --only hosting:journal --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:v2:build: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=journal-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-v2
scripts.deploy:v2: pnpm run deploy:v2:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:v2 --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:door:build: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_APP_FLAVOR=door VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=door-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-door
scripts.deploy:door: pnpm run deploy:door:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:door --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:voice:build: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_APP_FLAVOR=voice VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=voice-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-voice
scripts.deploy:voice: pnpm run deploy:voice:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:voice --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:game:build: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_APP_FLAVOR=game VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=game-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-game && node scripts/build-game-maps.mjs
scripts.deploy:game: pnpm run deploy:game:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:game --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:tent:build: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_APP_FLAVOR=tent VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=tent-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-tent
scripts.deploy:tent: pnpm run deploy:tent:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:tent --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:all:build: pnpm run build:cloud && pnpm run deploy:v2:build && pnpm run deploy:door:build && pnpm run deploy:voice:build && pnpm run deploy:game:build && pnpm run deploy:tent:build && pnpm run build:habits
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm run deploy:all:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:journal,hosting:v2,hosting:door,hosting:voice,hosting:game,hosting:tent,hosting:habits --project fitness-aos
scripts.build:habits: cd apps/habits && node scripts/ensure-kb-data.mjs && VITE_APP_MODE=client node ../../node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs
